name: kagi-news
description: Today's news from Kagi News, in four sections: World, Science, United States and Boston. Kagi rebuilds the feeds once each morning, so this is a daily edition rather than a live wire. Start with kagi_list_stories to see what is in today's edition — it returns headlines only and is cheap. Then kagi_get_story for the ones that matter: each body runs 4-15KB, so reading all 32 at once would spend most of a context on articles nobody asked about.
